purpose: Characterize a continuous near-saturation hydraulic closure that reuses the source-bound SWAP 4.3.1 H_ENPR finite-air-entry retention/matrix-conductivity base and replaces the incompatible legacy -2 cm linear-in-S KSATEXM extension by an endpoint-exact pressure-dependent log-conductivity bridge tied to Schaap and van Genuchten 2006.
identity_guards: This candidate is not SWAP 4.3.1 exact KSATEXM.

This candidate is not verbatim published MMVG 2006 because SWAP H_ENPR retention uses its own rational wet-end continuation and because V1 maps existing SWAP conductivity parameters rather than refitting K_o and L.
This candidate is not the NHI/MetaSWAP conservative near-saturation variant; its exact mapping remains a separate unresolved lineage.
The closure is physical configuration, not RossFast solver policy, and must be callable identically by FullRichards and RossFast before any solver-equivalence claim.

source_lineage.literature: Schaap MG, van Genuchten MT (2006), Vadose Zone Journal 5:27-34, doi:10.2136/vzj2005.0005
source_lineage.published_bridge_semantics: R decreases from 1 at h=0 to 0 at h=-40 cm, with a slope break at h=-4 cm and R(-4)=0.25; K=K_m*(K_s/K_m)^R.

frozen_v1_parameters_and_mapping.empirical_guard: Passing C2B does not establish that existing KSATFIT and LEXP are statistically optimal K_o and L values for the new bridge.

retention_law.definition: Use the exact SWAP 4.3.1 default-MvG H_ENPR theta(h) semantics with H_ENPR=-4 cm, including the normalized dry branch below h105=1.05*H_ENPR and the source rational continuation to theta_s above h105.

matrix_conductivity_law.source_identity: Exact SWAP 4.3.1 H_ENPR matrix-conductivity semantics, excluding legacy KSATEXM precedence.

R_exact_endpoint_form: R=(h+40)/144 for -40<h<-4 cm, giving exact R(-40)=0 and R(-4)=0.25
R=1+(3/16)*h for -4<=h<0 cm, giving exact R(-4)=0.25 and R(0)=1
near_saturation_bridge.relation_to_published_coefficients: The paper prints rounded coefficients 0.2778+0.00694h and 1+0.1875h. V1 uses the explicitly stated endpoints and break value exactly, so it is a documented endpoint-exact reconstruction rather than a verbatim rounded transcription.
expected_endpoint_properties: K is continuous at -4 cm because R is continuous and K_m is continuous/flat from H_ENPR upward
K remains positive for positive K_m and KSATEXM
near_saturation_bridge.continuity_class_claim: C0 only. One-sided derivative jumps at -40, -4 and 0 are allowed and must be quantified; V1 does not claim C1 continuity.

diagnostic_not_acceptance_metrics: one-sided dK/dh and d(logK)/dh at h=-40,-4,0
maximum K/C where C>0 over h=[-40,0]
MFP contribution from h=[-40,0] relative to h=[-10000,0]
comparison of wet-end stiffness with exact legacy KSATEXM and base H_ENPR/KSATFIT, without using either as a calibration target
difference between endpoint-exact R and the paper's printed rounded decimal form
explicit_nonclaims: No empirical goodness-of-fit claim for the 36 Staringreeks materials.
No FullRichards transient accuracy or equivalence claim.
No saturation-transition, groundwater, response-tangent or MultiSWAP production claim.
No combination with explicit SWAP macropore physics.

exit_rule.pass: Persist constitutive characterization and open a separate steady-face representation characterization with predeclared table candidates and unchanged physical closure.
exit_rule.fail: Fail-close V1 before any Ross table work. Any change to H_ENPR, parameter mapping, R(h), retention law or conductivity law is a new Class B physical-closure contract, not numerical retuning.
